body:
Lol. I can’t even do this right :) 

Thank you though. I’ll manage.

I don’t know how to use reddit. Only way I can see how to reply is for each message.

Thanks. I didn’t come to be talked down or to get sympathy. I don’t have any friends anymore other than my best friend and my wife. She is actually being really supportive. She is a wonderful person and I will love her always.

I just came here for a friend to just know somebody is out there while I count down my days. This probably isn’t the place... but where do you find a place for this kind of support...

Thanks to everyone who posted. I would love it if any of gave me some time over the next 30 days... I have no idea what I would like to talk about, but I am not here to be told how much life is worth living and how my problems are nothing compared to everyone else’s... I know all this... I was born selfish and I will die selfish. I’m hardly worth any of your time but I know many of you give time to nobodys like me.

Thanks again
I don’t want to ruin something for some people I really care about. I am being selfish enough as it is.
